intro: The Signature Mira Peel is Skin Essence's flagship glow treatment, performed on the MiraPeel system at our Kalyani Nagar clinic. Despite the name, it is not a chemical peel. MiraPeel is a German-developed serum delivery platform that combines hydradermabrasion, wet microneedling, vacuum extraction, lymphatic cupping, microcurrent and LED light therapy in a single session, so the skin is cleansed, resurfaced, infused and toned in one visit.

Hydradermabrasion uses a fine exfoliation tip with a vortex of water and serum to lift dead cells and tan without the scratching of crystal microdermabrasion. Gentle vacuum clears blackheads and congestion, then wet microneedling channels hydrating and brightening serums into the skin. Microcurrent tones the facial muscles and LED light calms acne and supports collagen. The result is an immediate glow, with skin that feels plumper and smoother for weeks.

Dr. Daksha Patel, an MD dermatologist with 17+ years of experience, chooses the steps and serums for each patient: a calming, hydrating protocol for sensitive or dry skin, a clarifying one for oily and acne-prone skin, and a brightening one for tan and dullness. There is no downtime, which is why the Mira Peel is the first step of most glow plans and the treatment we recommend closest to a wedding or event.
whoIsItFor: Dull, tired or dehydrated skin that needs a visible glow with no downtime
Blackheads, congestion and open pores that need gentle, painless extraction

aftercare: Sunscreen every morning; freshly exfoliated skin tans quickly without it.
Skip scrubs, retinoids and other actives for 3 days after the session.
No make-up for a few hours and no steam or sauna for 24 hours.
Keep water intake up; the infused serums work best in well-hydrated skin.

faqs.q: Is the Signature Mira Peel a chemical peel?
faqs.a: No. The name is the clinic's, but the treatment is performed on the MiraPeel system, which uses water-based hydradermabrasion, extraction, serum infusion, microcurrent and LED rather than acids. It suits skin that cannot tolerate chemical peels.

faqs.q: Does it hurt, and is there downtime?
faqs.a: No. Most patients describe a cool, tingling suction and find the session relaxing. There is no peeling, and the skin may look slightly pink for an hour or two.

faqs.q: How is it different from a HydraFacial?
faqs.a: MiraPeel includes hydradermabrasion much like a HydraFacial, and adds wet microneedling, microcurrent, lymphatic cupping and LED in the same session, so more can be addressed in one visit.

faqs.q: How often should I have it?
faqs.a: One session gives an event glow that lasts a few weeks. For ongoing improvement in hydration, texture and congestion, most patients repeat it every 4 to 6 weeks.

faqs.q: Can I have it a few days before my wedding?
faqs.a: Yes. Because there is no downtime, the Mira Peel can be done 2 to 5 days before an event. For the best result, start monthly sessions 2 to 3 months ahead.
